{{Short description|None}}
The '''2021 Copa Libertadores final stages''' were played from 13 July to 27 November 2021.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2021_02_10_2020.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2021: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=2 October 2020}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2021 Copa Libertadores]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/2021-libertadores-esp.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Libertadores 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref> with the final played in [[Montevideo]], [[Uruguay]] at [[Estadio Centenario]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/montevideo-sera-la-sede-de-las-finales-unicas-de-la-conmebol|title=Montevideo será la sede de las finales únicas de la CONMEBOL|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=13 May 2021|language=es}}</ref>

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams play a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie is played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2). If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] will be used. If still tied, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will not be played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.3).
*The final is played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.3.5). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 1 June 2021, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Center in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="Final stages draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/pautas-del-sorteo-de-octavos-de-final-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2021 |title=Pautas del sorteo de Octavos de Final de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=28 May 2021|language=es}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a group winner (Pot 1) and a group runner-up (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/cuadernillo_conmebol_libertadores_-_sorteo_octavos_de_final.pdf|title=SORTEO 2021 OCTAVOS DE FINAL|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=31 May 2021|language=es}}</ref><section end=Draw />
